description: "A Complete Edition of the Works of Nancy Luce" by Nancy Luce is a collection of writings, likely created during the mid-to-late 19th century. This multifaceted work encompasses poems, prayers, and personal reflections, addressing themes of compassion, spirituality, and a profound connection to animals, particularly chickens.
